g.text: GTEx representation agreement and concatenation gain
One point = one pair · all 66 pairs · mean across 10 matched assignments; lines = min–max
Raw representations · CKA: 999 transcripts; retrieval: 319 test rows; gains: gene-grouped five-fold probes.
Ranges are not confidence intervals. Retrieval follows registry order. No fitted trend or significance calculation.
